replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

I will review the points Iron stated, from our perspective.
A-0.08 seems fine, I've seen countless other people perform it and I don't see anything wrong with that.

B-0:39 this doesn't look legit whatsoever, you do not take any horizontal knockback, and this isn't delayed. You didn't take knockback afterwards either, which shows that the hits or kb isn't delayed.

C. 1:33 You locked onto most people in that group, when you have good aim, decent players do not make movements as such. You tried to hit the purple team member in that group fight, however your aim snapped at the cyan member (ref) then continued hitting the purple team. I highly doubt this is legit, because it's pretty blatant. In case you said you never locked onto the cyan member and just hit him without looking, the video clearly shows your aim snapping and hit, getting a hit, and switching back. I understand that you apparently killed me without looking at me aswell, but I've also seen people doing this and it's usually a visual glitch, plus, there is no evidence of you locking onto me at that part, so i will ignore that and only stick to the bold part.

D. 1:57  Refer to 1:59 at this clip, you try to run and hit a cyan member, however, as soon as some other cyan member sneaks up behind you, your head completely snaps at him and locks on.

Now about your replies:
You stated: "The one where I attack ref, I don't see where I "lock"  on but I do see I hit him without looking s, my only explanation for this is avicus registers hits very late compared to other servers and this becomes obvious when you have 13+ cps"

You do indeed log onto him, your head precisely locks onto him while you're trying to hit someone else. You do not hit him without looking, you snapped at him and hit him, then went back. This has nothing to do with hit registration, this is about your aim, and how it locks onto people even though you're obviously trying to hit someone else.

You also stated: "1:30 looks completely legit, it's not hard with aim and if I hack how come I'm not getting all the kills, since I would be hitting them first after utility delay is down to 0. I have no explanation for taking no knock back when I fight the guy on top of iron, but if I'm the one getting banned for kb on this server that's just really sad"

1:30 does not look legit whatsoever. Most your kills were probably stolen, just because you hack doesn't mean that you're supposed to get all the kills. We based the evidence off your aim, and other aspects such as the knockback you took. You take a great deal of knockback in the middle fight, however as soon as it got to the chance of you being knocked off in the iron, you literally took NO horizontal knockback. 

You also stated: "Also if 8 hack why am I not locking on to or auratix 2 40, and if I have anti kb why do I fly when Budha or jive hits me"

2:40 wasn't brought up. Please refer to the clips we stated, as they are the ones which you actually lock onto players in. Plus, referring to your second point, as I stated "You take a great deal of knockback in the middle fight, however as soon as it got to the chance of you being knocked off in the iron, you literally took NO horizontal knockback."
